articles.summary: BACKGROUND: Actinic keratosis (AK) and cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) form a biologically and morphologically continuous keratinocytic spectrum in which borderline lesions can be difficult to classify reproducibly. Previous optical studies have often focused on in-vivo spectra, binary tasks, or patch-level evaluation, leaving the patient-level three-class histopathology problem insufficiently studied.
